newsitem.title: POLAND: Wolczanka mulls production in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Wolczanka mulls production in Russia.

text.p: Polish garment maker Wolczanka SA is considering launching clothes production in Russia or Belarus for markets there, the firm's president Ryszard Polanski said on Thursday.
"We will consider whether to launch production in the east in the second half of the year or early in 1998," Polanski told Reuters.

"We want to expand production and not move it there.... Production in the east is much cheaper than in Poland," he said, adding that one of the Baltic republics would also be considered for production.
Polanski said Wolczanka, which employs 3,500 people, did not plan any collective lay-offs.
"Employment changes, if any are necessary, will be cosmetic," he said.
Polanski said he expected the company's net profit to be much higher in 1997 than last year's 5.6 million but gave no figure.
